The published chord-shape database output in
https://github.com/ShakaLei/open-source-orchestrator/tree/main/shapes is
identified by its publisher as CC0 1.0 Universal.

The complete CC0 1.0 legal code is available at:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

Clawford's normalized mandolin and 5-string banjo entries retain this
provenance as source.dataset "ohana" and source.license "CC0-1.0".
